scripts.build: bun build ./frontend/src/main.tsx --outfile ./frontend/dist/app.js --target browser --format esm --minify && cp frontend/src/styles.css frontend/index.html frontend/dist/
scripts.dev: wrangler d1 migrations apply dash-v --local && wrangler dev
scripts.deploy: wrangler d1 migrations apply dash-v --remote && wrangler deploy
